name: Fantasm Finance
fix_description: The mint(uint256,uint256) function (0x1b2ef1ca) has flawed collateral ratio calculation allowing users to mint more synthetic tokens than their collateral warrants. The collect() function (0xe5225381) then distributes the over-minted tokens. Fix: correct the mint calculation to properly account for collateral value, or add oracle-based price validation for the collateral ratio.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very simple two-step exploit: approve and call mint with an amount that triggers an obvious decimal/accounting error, then collect after one block. It involves only a single protocol contract, no flash loans or complex routing, and the PoC is short and straightforward.
